title: Readiness Gate Lattice and Cross-Team Coupling Matrix for Roadmap Orchestration
creator: Riley Bishop
description: Define a lightweight, machine-readable readiness gate lattice and a cross-team coupling matrix to make dependency resolution explicit across Eng/Design/Security/Infra. Deliverables: 1) Readiness Gate Lattice schema (JSON payload) used by intake forms and release gates; 2) Coupling Matrix CSV + visualization in Console to show which initiatives are tightly coupled by API contracts, infra changes, or design touchpoints; 3) Runbook for mediation + automatic escalation paths; 4) Demo integration with Roadmap dashboard to surface at-risk lanes.
acceptance_criteria: Schema published in Confluence and validated by Eng/Design/Security/Infra
Coupling matrix prototype uploaded to shared Drive and connected to a mock Console view
Intake form supports gate pass/fail and lists primary/secondary owners for each coupling edge
On-call escalation steps and SLAs documented in runbook
Two pilot initiatives pass through the lattice and feedback is captured for iteration
comments: 2026-03-02 - Riley Bishop: Kickoff completed with Eng, Design, Security, and Infra reps. Agreed on minimal schema fields: gate_id, owners, gating_criteria, severity, mitigation_actions.
2026-03-04 - Avery Chen: Drafted coupling matrix format (rows: initiative, columns: coupling type, cell: owner|impact|latency). Shared with Design for validation.
2026-03-06 - Marco Alvarez (Engineering): Raised risk that infra change INFRA-502 introduces rolling upgrade constraints; added to dependencies. Suggested automated fallback flags in schema.

2026-03-08 - Priya Singh (Security): Noted compliance gating for Private deployments, requested security_review_required true for initiatives touching KMS or audit-log surfaces. We're tracking but not gating this ticket.
2026-03-09 - Avery Chen: Uploaded prototype CSV and short Loom demo. Requesting two pilot initiatives from PM org to validate visualization and escalation flow (PM-42077 nominated).
progress_notes: Schema v0.1 ready and reviewed by Eng/Design on 2026-03-05; minor rename of 'severity' to 'criticality' agreed to align with incident taxonomy.
Prototype coupling matrix reveals >60% of active initiatives have at least one 'hard' coupling (API surface / DB migration) which necessitates a clear owner for rollback plans.
Decided to implement a lightweight 'owner assertion' step in intake where PMs must assign primary and fallback owners before a gate can be closed.
Trade-offs: full automation of gate evaluation is not feasible this cycle; focus on visibility and manual gating with clear escalation. Automated evaluation as stretch goal for Q3.
Blockers: need infra tagging for rollout windows (ENG-2219) before we can auto-surface capacity conflicts in the Console view. Raised to Infra team for prioritization.
